name: Поля й зв’язки
description:
You can also use the special attack 'pin' when attacking a piece + a mating square. Let's refresh your memory with an example.

What do you have to do?

Look for a piece and a vulnerable square behind it on the same line (file, rank or diagonal). Found one? Then use a piece of yours to set up a pin.

examples.text: The knight is unprotected. It is also noteworthy that black's bottom rank is vulnerable. A white queen on b8, d8, e8 or f8 is mate! Square f8 can be reached quickly! With 1.Qa3! White attacks the knight and indirectly the mate square f8. The knight and mating square are on the same line (diagonal in this case). Leaving the knight in its place would lose black material. However, if the knight moves black is mated: 1...Nd5 2.Qf8#.
